thesis: Microsoft je u fiskalnoj 2026. godini ostvario prihod od 331,84 milijarde USD, što je rast od 17,8% u odnosu na prethodnu godinu, uz neto dobit od 133,75 milijardi USD i razrijeđenu dobit po dionici (EPS) od 17,95 USD, naspram 13,64 USD u 2025. [1]. Profitabilnost je i dalje izuzetno visoka: bruto marža iznosi 67,9%, operativna 45,1%, a neto marža 40,3%, dok je omjer duga i kapitala nizak i iznosi 0,29 [1]. Ipak, slobodni novčani tok opada već dvije godine zaredom, sa 74,07 milijardi USD u 2024. na 66,99 milijardi USD u 2026. [1]. To je u skladu s upozorenjem kompanije da strategija u oblasti clouda i AI-ja zahtijeva značajna ulaganja, koja možda neće donijeti očekivani povrat [2]. Dionica po cijeni od 517,53 USD trguje ispod 52-sedmičnog maksimuma od 553,72 USD, s trenutnim P/E od 28,83 i forward P/E od 21,89 [1], pa je teza pozitivna, ali je uslovljena time da ulaganja u AI dovedu do održivog rasta prihoda u uslovima intenzivne konkurencije [2].

risks.text: We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which could adversely affect our results of operations.

Our cloud and AI strategy requires substantial investments and depends on evolving customer demand, technological developments, competitive dynamics, and regulatory conditions, any of which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Our success depends on our ability to develop, deliver, and maintain competitive cloud-based and AI products and services that achieve broad customer adoption and sustainable revenue growth.
We make significant investments in products and services that may not achieve expected returns.
Acquisitions, joint ventures, and strategic alliances could have an adverse effect on our business.
